accepted.s: Andhra Pradesh MedTech Zone (AMTZ), located at Visakhapatnam, is primarily associated with which sector?

accepted.s: The Mega Food Park at Mallavalli is located in which district of Andhra Pradesh?
accepted.x: The Mega Food Park at Mallavalli is located in Krishna district and includes a Central Processing Centre.

accepted.s:
Consider the following pairs:
1. A.P. Space City — Tirupati
2. A.P. Drone City — Kurnool
3. Tekulodu Aerospace and Defence Park — Sri Sathya Sai
4. Makavaripalem Organic Food Park — Anakapalli
Which of the pairs given above are correctly matched?
accepted.x: All four pairs are correctly matched under the parks proposed through BHAVYA.
accepted.tq: Check each sector-location pair before selecting the coded combination.

accepted.s: With reference to the parks proposed under BHAVYA, which one of the following is correctly matched?
accepted.x: The Renewable Energy Manufacturing Zone is proposed in Prakasam district. Veldurthi is in Palnadu, the Drone City is in Kurnool, and the Space City is in Tirupati.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure location and eliminate swapped districts.
accepted.sec: Sector-specific enterprises and parks → sector / location

accepted.s: Which of the following parks proposed under BHAVYA has the largest proposed area?
accepted.x: A.P. Space City at Tirupati has the largest proposed area, measuring 1,000 acres.
accepted.tq: Compare the figures in the park-area list.
accepted.sec: Sector-specific enterprises and parks → sector / location

accepted.s: The proposed area of the A.P. Drone City at Kurnool is:

accepted.tq: Direct numerical recall with nearby figures as distractors.

accepted.s: Which of the following is NOT correctly matched with its proposed area under BHAVYA?
o: Tekulodu Aerospace and Defence Park — 500 acres
accepted.x: The Renewable Energy Manufacturing Zone in Prakasam is proposed over 498 acres; the other three parks listed have an area of 500 acres.

accepted.s: How many parks were proposed under the Government of India's BHAVYA scheme in the set of projects identified for Andhra Pradesh?
accepted.x: Six parks were proposed: Space City, Drone City, Tekulodu Aerospace and Defence Park, Makavaripalem Organic Food Park, Renewable Energy Manufacturing Zone and Veldurthi Mega Textile Park.
accepted.tq: Count the complete named list rather than individual entries.
accepted.sec: Sector-specific enterprises and parks → sector / location

accepted.s: Visakhapatnam Steel Plant is operated by which organisation?
accepted.x: Visakhapatnam Steel Plant is operated by Rashtriya Ispat Nigam Limited (RINL).
accepted.tq: Match the industrial unit with its operating organisation.
accepted.sec: Major industrial units - Visakhapatnam Steel Plant, central PSUs in AP

accepted.s: Which statement regarding the Visakhapatnam Steel Plant is correct?
o: It is a coastal aluminium plant built with German collaboration and dedicated in 1992.
It is a shore-based integrated steel plant built with Soviet technical collaboration and dedicated to the nation on 1 August 1992.
It is a captive inland steel plant built with Japanese collaboration and dedicated in 1984.
It is a shipyard established by RINL in 2001 without foreign technical collaboration.
accepted.x: The Visakhapatnam Steel Plant is a shore-based integrated steel plant built with Soviet or USSR technical collaboration and dedicated to the nation on 1 August 1992.
accepted.tq: Combine plant character, collaboration and date without accepting a swapped detail.
accepted.sec: Major industrial units - Visakhapatnam Steel Plant, central PSUs in AP

accepted.s: Which of the following is NOT a central public sector undertaking located in Visakhapatnam as listed among the major industrial units of Andhra Pradesh?
accepted.x: HPCL Visakh Refinery, Hindustan Shipyard Limited and NTPC Simhadri are central PSUs in Visakhapatnam. Mangampet is known for its barytes deposit in Kadapa.
accepted.tq: Identify the item belonging to the mineral-resource category rather than the PSU list.
accepted.sec: Major industrial units - Visakhapatnam Steel Plant, central PSUs in AP

accepted.s: Cement production in Andhra Pradesh is concentrated mainly in which group of districts?
accepted.x: The principal concentration of cement industries is in YSR Kadapa, Kurnool and Guntur districts.
accepted.tq: District-cluster recall with geographically plausible alternatives.

accepted.s: Which one of the following is NOT included among the important mineral resources forming the mineral base of Andhra Pradesh?
accepted.x: Limestone, barytes, beach sands and granite are identified as important components of Andhra Pradesh's mineral base. Natural rubber is not included in this list.
accepted.tq: Odd-one-out from the stated mineral-resource group.

accepted.s: Mangampet in Kadapa district is particularly noted for which mineral deposit?
accepted.x: Mangampet in Kadapa has one of the world's largest barytes deposits.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding large and mega industrial units in Andhra Pradesh:
1. There were 1,074 operational large and mega units.
2. Their investment was ₹3.01 lakh crore.
3. They provided 5.33 lakh jobs.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The operational large and mega units numbered 1,074, involved ₹3.01 lakh crore investment and generated 5.33 lakh jobs.
accepted.tq: Verify all three figures in the same indicator row.
accepted.sec: Large and mega projects - number, investment, employment

accepted.s: How many large and mega projects, including PSUs, were under implementation in Andhra Pradesh?
accepted.x: Sixty large and mega projects, including PSUs, were under implementation.
accepted.tq: Separate the under-implementation count from the operational-unit count.
accepted.sec: Large and mega projects - number, investment, employment

accepted.s: By December 2024, how many large and mega units had been established in Andhra Pradesh during 2024-25?
accepted.x: Ten units had been established during 2024-25 up to December 2024.
accepted.tq: Use the time qualifier before selecting the count.
accepted.sec: Large and mega projects - number, investment, employment

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about SIPB approvals during FY 2024-25:
1. Eight projects were approved.
2. The approved investment was ₹2,45,275 crore.
3. The projects were expected to generate 65,541 jobs.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: SIPB approved eight projects involving ₹2,45,275 crore and 65,541 jobs during FY 2024-25.
accepted.tq: Test a complete statistical row through three linked statements.
accepted.sec: Large and mega projects - number, investment, employment

accepted.s: In June 2026, the Andhra Pradesh Cabinet ratified how many SIPB-vetted proposals worth ₹34,000 crore?
accepted.x: The Cabinet ratified 87 SIPB-vetted proposals worth ₹34,000 crore in June 2026.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the newer proposal count from earlier project counts.
accepted.sec: Large and mega projects - number, investment, employment

accepted.s: Which combination represents the broad areas associated with the 87 SIPB-vetted proposals ratified in June 2026?
o: Green energy, textile parks and eco-tourism
Medical devices, leather and fisheries only
Steel, coal mining and petroleum refining
accepted.x: The proposals covered green energy, textile parks and eco-tourism.
accepted.tq: Identify the correct sector grouping rather than a swapped industrial cluster.
accepted.sec: Large and mega projects - number, investment, employment

accepted.s: Manufacturing contributes approximately what share of the Gross State Domestic Product of Andhra Pradesh?
accepted.x: Manufacturing contributes about 11% of Andhra Pradesh's GSDP.
accepted.tq: Direct percentage recall with national MSME figures as distractors.

accepted.s: After bifurcation, the MSME profile of Andhra Pradesh shifted towards:
accepted.x: The post-bifurcation MSME profile shifted towards capital-intensive industries.
accepted.tq: Direct trend identification using extreme distractors.
accepted.sec: Industrial GVA of AP - sector shares and growth

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the national Index of Industrial Production framework:
1. The IIP base has been revised to 2022-23.
2. The revised core index contains nine industries.
3. Iron ore was added to the core index.
4. The revised weight of the core index is 32.88%.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The revised IIP framework uses 2022-23 as the base, has nine core industries after adding iron ore, and assigns them a 32.88% weight.
accepted.tq: Check the revised framework against the earlier eight-industry arrangement.
accepted.sec: Industrial GVA of AP - sector shares and growth

accepted.s: Which statement correctly contrasts the earlier and revised core-industry index weights?
o: The earlier nine-industry index had a 32.88% weight, while the revised eight-industry index has a 40.27% weight.
The earlier eight-industry index had a 40.27% weight, while the revised nine-industry index has a 32.88% weight.
Both the earlier and revised indices had a 40.27% weight.
Both the earlier and revised indices had a 32.88% weight.
accepted.x: The earlier core index covered eight industries with a 40.27% weight; the revised index has nine industries and a 32.88% weight.
accepted.tq: Compare both the count and weight before choosing the reversed-comparison trap.
accepted.sec: Industrial GVA of AP - sector shares and growth

accepted.s: Which statement regarding the contribution of Andhra Pradesh MSMEs to GSDP is correct?
o: They contribute 46% of Andhra Pradesh's GSDP.
They contribute 28% of Andhra Pradesh's GSDP.
The claim that they contribute 33.5% of GSDP was treated as incorrect.
accepted.x: The statement that Andhra Pradesh MSMEs contribute 33.5% of GSDP was keyed as incorrect; no alternative AP percentage is established here.
accepted.tq: Recognise the explicitly rejected percentage rather than importing national figures.
accepted.sec: Industrial GVA of AP - sector shares and growth

accepted.s: According to the national figures cited, the number of Udyam and Udyam Assist registrations from July 2020 to July 2025 was:
accepted.x: There were 6.63 crore Udyam and Udyam Assist registrations during the period July 2020 to July 2025.
accepted.tq: Use the date range to identify the national registration figure.
accepted.sec: Industrial GVA of AP - sector shares and growth

accepted.s: Which combination correctly states the cited national contribution of MSMEs?
o: About 46% of GDP, 30% of exports and 6.63 crore jobs
About 11% of GDP, 40.27% of exports and 9 lakh jobs
About 28% of GDP, 33.5% of exports and 2.72 crore jobs
About 30% of GDP, 46% of exports and 28 crore jobs
accepted.x: The cited national figures are about 30% of GDP, 46% of exports and 28 crore jobs.
accepted.tq: Keep percentage and employment figures in their correct columns.
accepted.sec: Industrial GVA of AP - sector shares and growth

accepted.x: Visakhapatnam is associated with engineering, life sciences, electronics, automobiles and metallurgy. Textiles and ceramics relate to West Godavari, while Nellore has leather, electronics and auto components.

2. East Godavari — Chemicals and petrochemicals
3. West Godavari — Textiles and ceramics
4. Guntur — Food processing and cement
Which of the pairs given above are correctly matched?

accepted.s: Which of the following district-sector pairs is NOT correctly matched?
o: Nellore — Leather, electronics and auto components
Kadapa — Agro and food processing, chemicals and petrochemicals

accepted.s: Which statement correctly describes the industrial-sector association of Kadapa and Anantapur?
o: Kadapa has leather and auto components, while Anantapur has cement.
Kadapa has petrochemicals, while Anantapur has ceramics only.
Both are associated only with mineral-based industries.
Both are associated with textiles, while Anantapur also has electronics.
accepted.x: Kadapa and Anantapur are associated with textiles; Anantapur additionally has electronics.
accepted.tq: Test the shared sector and the additional sector separately.
